_comment: Master control plane for ProductSnap Pulse editorial automation. GitHub scripts read this file but NEVER call AI. AI runs only inside Perplexity Computer. This file is the single source of truth for which automation phase is live, what the budget governor allows, and which quality gates apply. Edit deliberately; every field is reviewed in PRs.

_phase_meaning.0: Trigger decision is log-only. draft-editorial.js records KEEP/DRAFT but emits no handoff task. No AI anywhere.
_phase_meaning.1: Research agent SHADOW MODE. emit-editorial-task.js writes a typed handoff task on DRAFT. Computer research runner reads it, researches, writes findings + run record + ledger to the branch/artifact. Publishes NOTHING. No editorial rewrite. No auto-merge of AI interpretation.
_phase_meaning.2: Editorial agent drafts user-friendly content from findings. Validation agent runs the quality gate. Outputs are written to typed files and surfaced for human review. Still no auto-publish of AI interpretation.
_phase_meaning.3: Auto-publish of AI interpretation behind the quality gate at confidence_threshold. Green gate auto-merges its PR; yellow escalates; red holds safe.
_phase_meaning.4: Full steady-state automation with tuned thresholds.

kill_switch._comment: Hard global off-switch. When false, NO part of the editorial automation runs regardless of phase. Factual data refresh (fetch/validate/feed) is a separate pipeline and is UNAFFECTED by this switch.

_shadow_mode_meaning: When true, the AI layer may RESEARCH and WRITE reviewable artifacts but may NEVER publish, merge, or alter live Pulse content/data. Phase 1 forces this true.
_auto_publish_meaning: Master gate for letting any AI-written interpretation reach the live page. Phase 1/2 force this false. Only relevant at phase >= 3. When true (and shadow_mode false), a cycle that clears BOTH the GREEN verdict AND the higher publish_confidence_threshold AND a clean whole-page clarity scan publishes itself with no human in the loop.
_pause_auto_publish_meaning: Soft kill-switch for auto-publish ONLY. When true, every cycle holds (action held_below_bar) and publishes nothing, WITHOUT disarming the rest of the pipeline (research/draft/validate/gate still run and produce reviewable artifacts). Use this to temporarily stop live publishing without touching auto_publish_enabled. The hard global off-switch is kill_switch.editorial_automation_enabled.
_confidence_threshold_meaning: Minimum overall gate confidence required for a GREEN verdict (Phase 2 gate). YELLOW band is [0.70, 0.90); RED is < 0.70 or any hard-check failure. At phase >= 3 a GREEN verdict is eligible for auto-publish only when auto_publish_enabled is also true.
_publish_confidence_threshold_meaning: Separate, HIGHER bar required to actually AUTO-PUBLISH (default 0.95). A GREEN verdict (>= confidence_threshold) whose confidence is below this publish bar HOLDS SILENTLY and retries the next cycle instead of publishing. This is the macro-editor's '~95% sure or hold' rule.
_reading_grade_meaning: Editorial output must read at or below US grade 9 (Phase 2+ quality gate). Recorded in Phase 1 findings as a target only.

validation_panel._comment: Phase 3 multi-fold robustness. The single validation agent is replaced by a 3-judge adversarial panel of DIFFERENT providers (deliberately not the editorial drafter). The gate uses the WORST (minimum) confidence across judges for the GREEN/YELLOW/RED verdict, and only AUTO-PUBLISHES when ALL judges independently clear the publish bar (require_all_clear) AND no judge reports a hard issue. A single-judge ingest (--validate-ingest) is treated as a 1-judge panel for backward compatibility.

budget._comment: Real governor. check-budget.js reads the spend ledger and compares against these. In Phase 1 the governor is READ-ONLY/advisory: it records status but the deterministic data pipeline never depends on it. Dollar amounts are USD/month.
budget._downgrade_meaning: At >=70% of hard cap spent this month, model routing should prefer the cheapest acceptable candidate for each role (downgrade). At 100% of hard cap, STOP drafting new editorial interpretation — but factual data refresh continues uninterrupted.

phase1_exit_criteria._comment: Phase 1 ends and is reviewed when EITHER condition is first met. Then the user decides whether to proceed to Phase 2.

notifications._comment: Phase 1 notifies ONLY for hard failures, escalations, budget breaches, or a findings artifact that is ready for review. No success spam.

_threshold_autotune_meaning._comment: Control plane for the self-tuning editorial-exception-threshold loop (scripts/lib/threshold-evidence.js, threshold-outcomes.js + editorial-runner --record-evidence/--threshold-* subcommands). DETERMINISTIC scripts only; AI (recommender + validator) runs in Perplexity Computer as contracts, never in these scripts or GitHub Actions. This loop tunes ONLY the per-signal editorial `exception_threshold` (data/signals_registry.json), never the data-validation `thresholds` bounds, never any current_value.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.enabled: Master switch for the loop. When true, evidence is recorded and the recommend->validate->gate pipeline may run. When false, --threshold-tune-prep exits 3 (nothing to do).
_threshold_autotune_meaning.auto_apply: SHIP OFF. When false (current), the gate's action is 'propose': bounded changes are written to a WORKING-TREE registry copy for a human-reviewed PR; the registry on main is never written by the gate. When later armed true (like auto_publish_enabled), a rec that ALSO clears auto_apply_min_confidence may commit the registry change directly, bounded + logged + reversible. The auto_apply path is built and tested but dormant.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.min_events_per_signal: Evidence-volume gate. A signal needs at least this many evidence records before it is eligible for tuning — no tuning on a handful of data points. The loop correctly reports 'nothing to tune' (exit 3) until this accrues; that is expected, not a bug.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.review_cadence: How often the Computer-side cron checks for tunable signals (evidence-volume-triggered, checked monthly).
_threshold_autotune_meaning.max_relative_step: Hard cap on how far a single threshold may move per cycle: +/-15% relative to its current value. The deterministic gate re-clamps every recommendation to this regardless of what the AI proposed.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.cooldown_days: No second change to the same signal within this many days of its last change-log entry. Prevents fast drift / runaway feedback.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.recommender_model: model-registry.json role/id the recommender contract uses (swappable without code changes; falls back to roles.research.default).
_threshold_autotune_meaning.validator_model: model-registry.json id of the INDEPENDENT validator (a DIFFERENT provider than the recommender, mirroring the publish panel's anti-blind-spot principle; falls back to roles.validation.default).
_threshold_autotune_meaning.validator_min_confidence: A recommendation needs validator verdict=support AND confidence >= this AND would_cause_missed_signal=false to be eligible at the gate.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.auto_apply_min_confidence: Higher bar required for the eventual direct-apply path: even with auto_apply=true, a rec must clear this confidence to be applied directly rather than merely proposed.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.fp_rate_band: Analyzer notability band: a signal whose false-positive-candidate rate over its evidence reaches this is worth recommending a tune for.
_threshold_autotune_meaning.missed_rate_band: Analyzer notability band: a signal whose missed-signal-candidate rate over its evidence reaches this is worth recommending a tune for.

paths._comment: Relative to repo root. Handoff and audit file locations so every component agrees on where things live.
